title: The Sovereign Risk-Sharing Engine: testing a PRESCRIPTIVE fidelity floor on the recovered N=992 cohort (pre-registered and hash-locked BEFORE any gate was computed)
why_this_exists: The descriptive banking test failed twice. At N=27 the decoupled-underwriting design scored 2/4; at N=44 under the same locked gates it scored 1/4, with the portfolio advantage collapsing to an exact 9.1% tie while popularity out-discriminated enforcement latency by a wider margin (AUC 0.8635 vs 0.7792). The proposed reading is that raw capacity U carries momentum in an unguided environment -- large nodes coast on institutional backing long after their fidelity has degraded -- so a DESCRIPTIVE survival contest in that environment will systematically reward status over protocol work. This pre-registration exists to test that reading instead of assuming it.
the_unfalsifiability_hazard_stated_up_fr: IMPORTANT AND DELIBERATE. 'The test failed, which proves the environment is broken, which validates our prescriptive design' is the structure of an unfalsifiable theory. If adopted without a falsifiable consequence it would immunise the framework against all future evidence, and would be a fatal methodological defect regardless of how compelling the underlying reasoning is. This document therefore refuses the immunising move and converts the claim into a prediction that CAN COME OUT WRONG. The 'capacity momentum masks fidelity' explanation has a hard, checkable consequence: if U-momentum is what conceals D, then WITHIN STRATA OF SIMILAR U the fidelity signal must reappear. If enforcement latency adds nothing to default discrimination even after capacity is held constant, then capacity is not masking fidelity -- fidelity simply is not carrying the information, the descriptive failures are not explained by environment, and the prescriptive design loses its empirical motivation and must be reported as such. That is gate P1, and it is the make-or-break gate of this entire experiment.
prior_disclosure_confirmatory_risk: This is NOT a blind pre-registration. The N=992 cohort already exists and its LISM-level published statistics are known to the analyst (N=992, 750 failed / 242 survived, VIF 1.0203, dAIC -3.483, tau_fail 50.61 d vs tau_surv 19.76 d, verdict QUADRATIC_DISCONFIRMED). What has NOT been computed at lock time is any banking gate: no stratified AUC, no floor-binding fraction, no portfolio tail statistic, no unearned-capacity contrast. Those are the quantities this spec governs. The known third-law direction (failed repos have higher tau_v) means P1 is not starting from zero information; that is disclosed here rather than concealed, and P1 is deliberately set as a threshold test (weighted within-stratum AUC > 0.55) rather than a mere direction test, so a weak-but-positive residual signal still FAILS.

data.cohort: data/github/govphys_quadratic_results.csv -- the recovered N=992 pre-registered GitHub cohort (spec cac34f44), verified by recomputation from its rows against CI run 74994532125 (cohort-audit/verify_992_recovery.py, 7/7). Committed.
data.outcome: default = (E == 0), i.e. the repository failed. 750 defaults / 242 performing. The outcome is lifecycle failure, measured independently of stars and of tau_v, so it is non-circular with respect to every predictor used here.
data.D: D = D_enc * D_dec, the committed two-hop fidelity product.
data.imputation_handling: DECLARED CONFOUND. The cohort carries a tau_v_imputed flag; 15.5% of failed and 4.1% of performing rows have imputed latency, an asymmetry that could by itself manufacture a tau_v effect. The PRIMARY analysis for every gate uses MEASURED-ONLY rows (tau_v_imputed == 0). The full sample is reported as a SECONDARY read. If the two disagree, the measured-only result governs and the disagreement is reported.

the_design_being_tested: A full-reserve, non-lending intermediary. Capital is deployed as equity (profit-and-loss sharing), never as interest-bearing debt; the institution is barred from fractional-reserve credit creation; admission is governed by a PRESCRIPTIVE fidelity floor D >= D_min rather than by status; and evaluation is decoupled (F_out = F_eval), scoring candidates on verified behaviour rather than self-reported standing. D_min is fixed at the 40th percentile of D across the FULL cohort -- an outcome-free quantile, chosen before running so it cannot be tuned to a result.

gates.P1_fidelity_survives_capacity_stratifica: MAKE-OR-BREAK, AND THE HONEST TEST OF THE 'CAPACITY MOMENTUM' EXPLANATION. Stratify the cohort into quintiles of stars. Within each stratum compute AUC(tau_v -> default). Report the sample-size-weighted mean across strata. PASS iff the weighted within-stratum AUC > 0.55 AND AUC > 0.5 in at least 3 of the 5 strata. FALSIFIABLE AND EXPECTED TO BE AT REAL RISK: if holding capacity constant does not restore the fidelity signal, the claim that U-momentum was masking D is WRONG, and this must be reported as the collapse of the prescriptive design's empirical motivation -- not reinterpreted.
gates.P2_the_floor_actually_binds: A floor that excludes nobody is decorative. The D >= D_min admission rule must exclude at least 20% of the TOP-QUINTILE-BY-STARS nodes. PASS iff the excluded fraction of high-status nodes >= 0.20. CAN FAIL: if high-status nodes almost all clear the fidelity floor, then status and fidelity agree in this population and the floor adds nothing over a prestige screen.
gates.P3_tail_risk_not_mean_risk: THE CORRECTED PORTFOLIO CLAIM. The earlier design predicted a lower MEAN default rate and that prediction died at N=44. Risk-sharing does not primarily claim a better average; it claims a better-behaved DOWNSIDE. Build two books of equal size: conventional (top stars) and sovereign (D >= D_min, then lowest tau_v). Bootstrap each 2000 times (seed 42) and compare the 95th percentile of the default-rate distribution. PASS iff the sovereign book's 95th percentile is strictly lower. CAN FAIL, and a failure means the floor does not improve the tail either -- a second, independent defeat that must be reported at full force.
gates.P4_unearned_capacity_inflation_predicts_: THE RIBA PREDICTION, made falsifiable. Unearned capacity inflation is defined operationally as high capacity carried on degraded fidelity: stars in the top quintile AND D < D_min. The claim is that this configuration is genuinely pathological rather than merely unusual. PASS iff the default rate among high-star/low-D nodes EXCEEDS the default rate among high-star/high-D nodes. CAN FAIL: if inflated-capacity nodes default no more often than their high-fidelity peers, the pathology is not detectable in this population and the claim is not supported here.
gates.P5_full_reserve_invariant: STRUCTURAL SPEC CHECK, NOT EVIDENCE. Simulate the intermediary's balance sheet over the sovereign book: total claims issued must never exceed deposits received, and no contract may create a claim on money that was not deposited. DECLARED UP FRONT AS falsifiable:false -- this is a property of the implementation, enforced by construction, and it CANNOT come out false. It is reported as a specification conformance check and must never be counted as empirical support for anything.
gates.P6_decoupled_evaluation_changes_the_allo: F_out = F_eval. Ranking by self-reported status must differ materially from ranking by verified fidelity: Spearman rho between the star-rank and the fidelity-rank must be < 0.50, AND at least one top-decile-by-stars node must sit below the fidelity floor. PASS iff both hold. Partly construction-favoured -- if the two rankings were identical the floor could not bind -- so it is reported as SUPPORTING, not as independent confirmation, and P2 carries the substantive version of this claim.

symmetric_null: Every AUC, quantile, rate and rho is reported with its exact value whether or not it favours the design. P1, P2, P3 and P4 are all genuinely at risk. A failure of P1 in particular must be reported as falsifying the capacity-momentum explanation itself, which is the load-bearing argument for building the prescriptive system at all. No threshold in this file may move after the lock; a missed gate is recorded as missed and asserted in the test suite. If the measured-only and full-sample analyses disagree, both are printed and the measured-only result governs.
what_a_pass_would_and_would_not_mean: Passing P1-P4 would establish that fidelity carries default information once capacity is held constant, that a fidelity floor excludes a real and worse-performing slice of high-status nodes, and that the floored book has a better tail. It would NOT establish that the intermediary is more profitable, that it would survive competitively against leveraged institutions, that these findings transfer from software repositories to human borrowers, or that any normative or theological claim is correct. Software repositories are a proxy substrate chosen because it has non-circular lifecycle outcomes at N=992, not because it resembles a credit market.
acceptance: GREEN when this spec re-hashes to its published canonical SHA-256, the cohort re-hashes to the sha256 recorded by the recovery verification, and P1-P6 are evaluated exactly as written -- with every miss recorded, asserted in tests, and carried into the README. Exit 0 means 'reproduces including its failures', never 'the design is validated'.
